faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions below.
faq.noResults: No questions found matching your search.
faq.ctaText: Our support team is ready to help you 24/7.
faq.q1: How do I place an order?
faq.a1: Browse products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You can pay securely with multiple payment options.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We accept credit/debit cards, Vodafone Cash, and cash on delivery for eligible areas.
faq.a3: Standard delivery takes 2-5 business days. Express delivery is available for select locations.
faq.q4: Can I return or exchange an item?
faq.a4: Yes, we offer a 14-day return policy for unused items in original packaging.
faq.q5: How do I track my order?
faq.a5: Once shipped, you will receive an email with a tracking link to monitor your delivery status.
faq.a6: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption and never share your data with third parties.
